verdict.rationale: Weaviate is open source and can be self-hosted via Docker, Kubernetes, or as an embedded Python package, which lets users decide exactly where their data lives. Backups can also be sent to a cloud blob store of the user's choosing (S3, GCS, Azure), so residency control comes from operating your own infrastructure rather than from a managed region picker. Missing for 10: documented region selection for Weaviate Cloud, data-residency guarantees or compliance documentation, independent corroboration of residency controls.
